host: WSL2, 12 cores, 47 GB, local NVMe-backed VHDX
notes: The build no longer holds a text column's prose in entity order. Each chunk the attribute join stages is sorted by entity already, so each chunk of each text column is written out as one record-blob extent under .build-tmp/; the text index reads those extents in block windows and the record blob merges them with the entity-ordered columns (docs/design/build-prose-extents.md). The bundle is byte-identical to the 2026-09-04 arena build's: 46 files compared, none differing but MANIFEST.json's created_at and the CURRENT that carries its digest.

4,169.9 s end to end against 10,578.4 s. attribute_tail falls from 6,369.1 s to 890.2 s because --arena-order auto now sees only openalex_id's 1,456 MiB of keyword payload and chooses arrival, so the source's prose is decoded once. record_blob 777.4 s at 16 major faults a second, text_index 1,688.4 s over the same 57,637,877 terms, peak VmHWM 19,590 MiB against 29,239.
The serve and ingest blocks below are the 2026-09-04 arena build's and were not re-measured: the bundle is byte-identical, so what a request costs over it cannot have moved.
Rung 5's serve batteries ran on the same disk throughout this build, where the arena build had the disk to itself. The stage walls are therefore an upper bound.
